title: Lead Estimator
description:
About the role

For more than 60 years, Complex has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


We are looking for a Lead Estimator, this role will provide support and technical advice to our estimating team, deliver accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for civil & construction projects, while also providing oversight and tender coordination to the estimating team.


The Lead Estimator is a critical role that remains hands-on in the preparation of tenders while contributing to pricing strategy, subcontractor engagement, and achieving tendering milestones.


Key responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate and competitive cost estimates, budgets, and scopes of work for civil construction tenders
  • Review tender documentation (drawings, specifications, RFTs, contracts) to confirm scope, risks, and opportunities
  • Conduct and/or coordinate site inspections to assess conditions and identify construction risks
  • Perform and review quantity take-offs using Benchmark, Revu, and Excel
  • Prepare detailed cost build-ups, subcontractor comparisons, and pricing reconciliations
  • Analyse historical project data to support pricing accuracy and continuous improvement
  • Promote consistent estimating methodologies, tools, and documentation standards
  • Maintain effective working relationships with key subcontractors and suppliers

About you

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in commercial construction / civil infrastructure estimating
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and leading complex civil tenders
  • Strong understanding of civil, building and construction methodologies, contract review and risk identification, and cost planning and pricing strategy
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior and mid-level estimators
  • High-level competency in Benchmark, Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Project (Intermediate level)
  • Ability to manage multiple tenders and competing deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Well-developed interpersonal, negotiation, and organisational skills


If this sounds like you please APPLY reach out to Ebony Ison, ebony.ison@complexco.com.au

title: Projektleiter / Bauleiter MSR und Gebäudeautomation (m/w/d)
description:
Gebäudeautomation ist für Sie mehr als ein Schaltschrank mit Blinklicht? Sie verstehen, wie MSR-Technik, DDC, Inbetriebnahme, Schnittstellen und Bauablauf zusammenhängen – und möchten Verantwortung für Projekte übernehmen, bei denen Technik wirklich wirken muss?

Für ein etabliertes mittelständisches Unternehmen aus der Technischen Gebäudeausrüstung suchen wir im Rahmen der Direktvermittlung eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit für den Bereich MSR und Gebäudeautomation. Das Unternehmen plant und realisiert technische Gebäudesysteme über mehrere Gewerke hinweg und verbindet Elektrotechnik, HLS, MSR und Projektumsetzung in einem praxisnahen Umfeld.

Diese Position ist ideal für Menschen, die Gebäudeautomation nicht nur theoretisch kennen, sondern auch im Projektalltag, auf der Baustelle und in der Abstimmung mit Kunden, Technikern und Nachunternehmern sicher bewegen können.

Aufgaben

Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für laufende Bauvorhaben im Bereich MSR und Gebäudeautomation. Dabei steuern und koordinieren Sie Mitarbeitende, Nachunternehmer, Material und Abläufe und sorgen dafür, dass Qualität, Termine und Ergebnisse zusammenpassen.

Sie unterstützen fachlich bei DDC-Programmierungen, Inbetriebnahmen und Dokumentationen und behalten gleichzeitig die administrative Seite der Projekte im Blick. Dazu gehören technische Planung, Kalkulation, Rechnungslegung, Nachtragsmanagement und die Überwachung der Baustellenergebnisse.

Sie arbeiten eng mit angrenzenden Bereichen der Anlagentechnik zusammen, stimmen Bauabläufe ab und sind Ansprechpartner für interne und externe Projektbeteiligte. Auch Kundenkontakt und die Weiterentwicklung der Abteilung können Teil Ihrer Rolle sein.

Kurz gesagt: Sie verbinden Technik, Organisation und Führung in einem Bereich, der für moderne Gebäude immer wichtiger wird.

Qualifikation

Sie haben ein Studium der Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder eine technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker abgeschlossen.

Wichtig sind Erfahrung in MSR-Technik, Gebäudeautomation, DDC, GLT oder vergleichbaren Systemen sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Bauabläufe und Projektsteuerung. Kenntnisse gängiger Normen, technischer Vorschriften und Kalkulationsgrundlagen sind hilfreich.

Erfahrung mit bestimmten Systemherstellern ist ein Vorteil, aber entscheidend ist nicht nur ein einzelnes Fabrikat. Wichtiger ist, dass Sie Gebäudeautomation grundsätzlich verstehen, technische Zusammenhänge erklären können und im Projektalltag strukturiert, kostenbewusst und lösungsorientiert handeln.

Sie sollten sicher auftreten, klar kommunizieren und Freude daran haben, technische Teams, Kunden und Projektbeteiligte zusammenzuführen.

Benefits

Sie erhalten eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem zukunftsstarken technischen Umfeld mit langfristiger Perspektive.

Geboten werden eine attraktive Vergütung, 30 Urlaubstage, jährliche Sonderzahlungen abhängig von Leistung und Unternehmenserfolg, eine strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie ein Dienstfahrzeug. Die private Nutzung kann individuell besprochen werden.

Weiterbildungen werden finanziell und zeitlich unterstützt. Zusätzlich bietet das Unternehmen betriebliche Altersvorsorge, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein Umfeld, in dem MSR und Gebäudeautomation nicht als Randthema laufen, sondern als wichtiger Bestandteil moderner technischer Gebäudeausrüstung.

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung oder eine unverbindliche Kontaktaufnahme. Auch wenn Sie bisher eher aus der Inbetriebnahme, Systemtechnik oder Projekttechnik kommen und sich in Richtung Bauleitung oder Projektverantwortung entwickeln möchten, lohnt sich ein Gespräch.

We help manufacturers - one of the most essential and overlooked sectors of our economy - run better. Every car, wind turbine, medical device, and washing machine comes from a factory. title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.
  • Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations.
  • Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections.
  • Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility.
  • Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results.


That makes you stand out

  • You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field.
  • You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch.
  • You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, or multi-view vision.
  • Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial.
  • Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level). Knowledge of German is desirable but not required.


Salary information

Within our standardized and transparent salary framework, the pay for this position ranges from €15.50 to €19.50 per hour and is based on various factors, such as qualifications and experience.

title: Software Engineer - Data (All Genders)
description:
Hey!

Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves.
Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too.
That's exactly what we're building every single day.


Main information

  • Start: Immediately
  • Location: Cologne, Berlin London or Remote
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Team: Teamwear/Tech


Is this a match?

The most important basics – so we both know if it could work.

  • 100% remote: This role is generally available 100% remote within the EU or UK. If you'd still love to work from one of our offices in Cologne, Berlin or London - you're more than welcome.
  • Experience: You bring 6-8 years of experience in software engineering and data engineering.
  • Languages: You speak English fluently - German is a big plus.
  • Startup spirit: You'd rather shape things than just tick boxes - even when that means figuring stuff out without a finished roadmap.


Your playing field

Here's why this role matters for our mission.

  • Teamwear is one of our three company headlines, but technically it currently depends on one person.
  • As long as this remains the case, the area cannot scale beyond its current scope.
  • Your goal: To enable Teamwear to scale beyond its current scope.


How you'll make a difference

This is how you move our mission forward every day.

  • Data Pipelines: You build and maintain data pipelines for automated data collection, structured so that new sources and markets can be added quickly.
  • Algorithms: You develop algorithms to extract relevant information from websites and images.
  • Data Quality: You ensure data quality through validation, confidence levels, monitoring, and clean handovers internally and to partners.
  • Data Infrastructure: You manage and further develop the data infrastructure of the Teamwear area.
  • Technical Point of Contact: You act as the second technical point of contact for the Teamwear area.
In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also:
  • Internal Tools: You develop internal tools that enable the team to collect and correct data themselves.
  • Analytics & Reports: You create analytics and reports for internal stakeholders and external partners.


What you bring to the table

We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.

  • Broad Technical Skillset: You move between data pipelines, backend and some frontend, and are not afraid of AI or image analysis.
  • Data Automation: You have experience with automated data pipelines, web scraping and image processing.
  • Databases & Data Modelling: You have expertise in databases and data modelling.
  • Independent Working: You work independently, even when there is no second engineer in the room and the context comes from business teams.
  • Fast Learner: You quickly get familiar with unfamiliar domains and ask the right questions along the way.
  • 80/20 Mindset: You know when fast and good enough is the right approach and when the data needs to be 100% accurate because a decision is based on it.
  • Data Quality: You care about details when it comes to data quality and make uncertainties explicit.
  • Data-Driven Thinking: You don't stop at analysing the data. You identify what is in the data, what it means and what we should look at next - even if nobody asked.
  • Engineering Practice: You write clean, maintainable code and follow good engineering practices such as testing and code reviews.
  • Tools: Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Grafana, Metabase, Pulumi, Kubernetes, AWS, LLM APIs
Good to know
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
  • If you are looking for clearly defined tickets, a large engineering team and a finished tech stack, this role is probably not for you.
    • You will work largely as a team of two within Engineering. Most of your day-to-day work will be with business people, not engineers.
    • You have two connections: technically to Engineering and on the content side to the Teamwear team. This gives you a lot of freedom and means you need to set your own priorities.
    • A large part of the role is data collection and data quality, rather than greenfield ML. The exciting part is turning messy, real-world sources into reliable data.
    • The area is new. There is no finished setup for you to work with - you will help build it.
    • AI-first: We work AI-first, and AI tools are an active part of our workflow.


Bonus

Not a must - but this'll definitely earn you extra points.

  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes or IaC (Pulumi/Terraform). You can also learn this with us.
  • Experience presenting and preparing data for non-technical audiences.
  • A personal connection to amateur football.


Benefits

We want you to love joining us - and still love being part of the team a long time from now. 

  • Be part of it from the start – Shape how Prematch grows and transforms amateur football.
  • Competitive salary – You’ll be paid fairly and transparently.
  • Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success.
  • Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!
  • Remote work - depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote - whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote.
  • Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
  • Team spirit - whether in the office or at home, we use cool tools and a virtual office to keep the team tightly connected.
  • Modern IT equipment - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
  • 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
  • Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
  • Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.


Still here? Sounds like a pretty good match.

If you've made it this far, we hope we've managed to show you one thing: how we work, what we believe in and why this role at PREMATCH is something special.
Maybe this is exactly the moment you've been waiting for: a team that thinks big, a vision that actually moves things and the chance to help reshape amateur football digitally – together with us.

Now it's your turn.

  • Click on ‘Apply now’ - it’ll only take 2 minutes.
  • All we need is your CV. You can tell us the rest in our simple, short application form.
  • Don’t meet all the requirements? If you think you’re still a good fit - just apply

  • Du bist konzeptionsstark, arbeitest strukturiert und kannst komplexe Gedanken klar und prägnant auf den Punkt bringen.
  • Du hast ein starkes intrinsisches Interesse an neuen Trends, Innovationen, Sport und Marketing.

  • Du hast exzellente sprachliche und gestalterische Fähigkeiten, die es dir ermöglichen, hervorragende Präsentationen für unsere Kunden zu erstellen (Power Point und KI-Tools sind deine Geheimwaffe!)
  • Du kannst sowohl strategisch basiert arbeiten als auch unkonventionell und kreativ denken, um neue Kreativansätze zu entwickeln.

Warum wir?

Bei der WWP erwarten dich die faszinierende Welt des Sports und die erfolgreichsten Marken - sie sind seit 40 Jahren unser tägliches Umfeld. Wir setzen auf Leidenschaft, Individualität und Erfahrung. Zeig uns, was dich auszeichnet! 
Wir sind gespannt auf deine kreativen Highlights. Bitte füge deiner Bewerbung ein aussagekräftiges Portfolio mit ausgewählten Konzepten, Kampagnen oder Textarbeiten bei.

title: Technical Solutions Engineer
description:
Short description

Join Septeo CNEE and support challenging client projects in the insolvency industry from the initial requirements gathering through to successful implementation. You’ll combine technical expertise with consulting skills to develop customized solutions for complex business processes. Rather than working on a standard product or processing tickets, you’ll collaborate with our clients to design customized workflows, migrations, and integrations that deliver direct, practical value.

If you enjoy taking on responsibility, contributing to technical development, and interacting with clients, we look forward to receiving your application.

This role is available throughout Germany. Since interacting with clients and the team is a key part of the position, we expect you to be present at our Karlsruhe office on a regular basis and to attend occasional on-site client meetings.


Your mission

  • Design and development of custom extensions, interfaces, workflows, and integrations based on C#/.NET, VBA, and XML
  • Further development and maintenance of an Access-based business application and the underlying MS SQL Server database structures
  • Integration and development of digital case management solutions (eIP, e2A), the Electronic Court and Administrative Mailbox (EGVP), and the integration of electronic signatures
  • Development of pragmatic and sustainable solutions for complex business and technical requirements
  • Consulting and technical support for clients in the digitization and optimization of business processes in the insolvency sector
  • Technical coordination with clients and collaboration with specialized departments within the judiciary
  • Preparation of technical documentation and ensuring proper version control using Git


Your profile

  • Several years of work experience in software development or technical consulting in a project-oriented environment
  • In-depth knowledge of C#/.NET, MS Access, MS SQL Server, VBA, and ideally modern web technologies such as Angular, React, or Blazor
  • Experience in analyzing business requirements as well as designing, implementing, and deploying custom software solutions, integrations, and migrations
  • Experience working with electronic signatures and, ideally, electronic legal transactions (e.g., EGVP) or comparable regulated environments
  • A strong understanding of business processes, as well as a passion for providing technical consulting and collaborating with clients
  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to work, combined with strong communication and teamwork skills
  • Excellent English and German language skills


Application process

Digital Get-to-Know-You Session 
During a brief conversation with our recruiters, we’ll discuss our mutual expectations.
Technical Interview
Next, you’ll get to know the department and gain deeper insights into our projects, technologies, and way of working.
Introduction day in Karlsruhe
Finally, you’ll visit our headquarters in Karlsruhe. You’ll meet the team, gain insights into real client projects, and get an authentic sense of how we collaborate and work.


Benefits

Our full range of benefits and perks is explained as part of our recruiting process, but you can already get a good overview on our careers page: https://www.stp.one/en/careers
As a European company, our benefits vary by country, but some benefits apply to all employees:

  • Annual training budget and defined career paths
  • Employee referral bonus
  • Mobility: e.g., bike leasing, public transportation subsidies
  • Workation: up to 30 days per year within the EU

title: Prozessingenieur
description:
MicroHarvest ist ein schnell wachsendes scale-up in Hamburg, das mithilfe von Mikroorganismen, durch ein nachhaltiges Verfahren, besseres, gesünderes und schmackhafteres Protein produzieren wird. Damit leistet MicroHarvest einen Beitrag zur nachhaltigen Lösung der globalen Herausforderung, die Weltbevölkerung zu ernähren. Freuen Sie sich auf ein kollegiales und dynamisches Umfeld, in dem Sie mit einem Team zusammenarbeiten, das über fundierte Erfahrung in den Bereichen Biotechnologie, Wirtschaft und Produktentwicklung verfügt.

Bist du ehrgeizig, praxisorientiert und begeisterst dichh für Aufgaben mit echtem Potenzial statt engen Grenzen? Bei MicroHarvest unterstützt du nicht nur die Produktion – du gestaltest sie mit. Von der Produktionssteuerung mit externen Partnern bis hin zum Aufbau unserer ersten Industrieanlage bietet diese Position vom ersten Tag an außergewöhnliche Eigenverantwortung, Sichtbarkeit und Wachstumspotenzial. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Führungskräften zusammen, erhätst tiefe Einblicke in den Scale-up von industrieller Biotechnologie und hast die Chance, dich im Zuge des Unternehmenswachstums zu einer wichtigen Führungskraft im operativen Bereich zu entwickeln. Wenn du in dynamischen Umgebungen aufblühst, in denen Strukturen noch im Aufbau sind, und konkrete Spuren hinterlassen möchtest, würden wir dich gerne kennenlernen.

Tasks

Aufgaben

Kurzfristig: Eigenproduktion bei unserem CMO

  • Funktion als operativer und technischer Ansprechpartner von MicroHarvest bei unserem Lohnhersteller (CMO)
  • Leitung der Produktionsaktivitäten beim CMO mit einem hohen Maß an Eigenverantwortung
  • Regelmäßige Reisen zum Standort (in der Regel 1–2 Mal pro Monat für 3–5 Tage), um Produktionskampagnen zu unterstützen, Probleme zu lösen, Prioritäten abzustimmen und die Qualität der Ausführung sicherzustellen
  • Überwachung der Prozessleistung, Identifizierung von Engpässen und Vorantreiben von Verbesserungen bei Durchsatz, Ausbeute, Qualität und Robustheit
  • Behebung von Abweichungen und Bewältigung von Herausforderungen bei der Skalierung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Teams
  • Aufbau fundierten Know-hows über unseren industriellen Prozess und Entwicklung zum führenden Experten des Unternehmens für die Großproduktion

Parallel dazu: Vorbereitung unserer ersten Industrieanlage

  • Unterstützung bei der Planung, dem Aufbau und der Inbetriebnahme der ersten industriellen Produktionsstätte von MicroHarvest
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem zukünftigen Standortleiter, um Prozessanforderungen in die Realität der Anlage umzusetzen
  • Mitwirken bei der Auswahl der Ausrüstung, den Betriebskonzepten, dem Prozesslayout, der Standortvorbereitung und der Hochlaufplanung
  • Mitgestalten, wie die Anlage und der Standort für einen sicheren, effizienten und skalierbaren Betrieb eingerichtet werden sollen
  • Sicherstellen, dass in allen Projektphasen – vom Engineering bis zur Inbetriebnahme – eine starke betriebliche Ausrichtung im Vordergrund steht

Mit der Zeit: Entwicklung hin zu einer Führungsrolle im Werk

  • Werde zur rechten Hand und zum Stellvertreter des zukünftigen Werksleiters
  • Übernehme zunehmend Verantwortung in den Bereichen Betrieb, Verfahrenstechnik und Anlagenbereitschaft
  • Helfe mit, die Systeme, die Disziplin und die Kultur aufzubauen, die für eine leistungsstarke Produktionsorganisation erforderlich sind
  • Entwickel dich in Richtung stellvertretender Werksleiter, mit der Aussicht, in Zukunft eine umfassendere Führungsrolle am Standort zu übernehmen

Requirements

Anforderungen

  • Abschluss in Maschinenbau, Chemieingenieurwesen, Bioingenieurwesen, Biotechnologie oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der industriellen Produktion oder im Anlagenbau (Biotechnologie, Fermentation, Lebensmittel- oder chemische Industrie)
  • Erfahrung in der Fehlerbehebung und Prozessoptimierung in einer Produktionsumgebung
  • Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und operative Themen mit externen Partnern zu koordinieren
  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen zu Produktionsstandorten
  • Bereitschaft zum Umzug in den Raum Halle/Leipzig
  • Flüssige Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch (weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil)

Benefits

Warum bei uns arbeiten?

MicroHarvest ist nicht einfach nur ein weiteres Unternehmen. Wir sind:

  • Wirkungsorientiert: Unsere Mission ist es, schon heute besseres Protein anzubieten: nachhaltig, nährstoffreich und skalierbar.
  • Schnell wachsend: Mit der Unterstützung führender Investoren wachsen wir rasant und wollen dieses Wachstum gemeinsam mit dir vorantreiben.
  • Teamorientiert: Sie arbeiten Seite an Seite mit unseren Gründern, Wissenschaftlern und Führungskräften aus dem Vertrieb und lernen jeden Tag dazu.
  • Einzigartige Kultur: Ein internationales, hilfsbereites und sympathisches Team, das Vielfalt und Neugier schätzt.

Hier trägt Ihre Arbeit nicht nur zum Wachstum eines Unternehmens bei. Sie verändert eine ganze Branche

Bei MicroHarvest legen wir großen Wert auf Vielfalt und diskriminieren daher niemanden aufgrund von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität oder -ausdruck, nationaler Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Veteranenstatus, Familienstand oder aufgrund der Zugehörigkeit einer Person zu einer durch geltende Gesetze geschützten Gruppe oder Klasse. MicroHarvest ermutigt Menschen aller Hintergründe und aus unterrepräsentierten Gruppen ausdrücklich, sich auf diese Stelle zu bewerben.

title: Ingenieur Medizintechnik / Healthcare Planning (w/m/d) Bozen (IT) - Unbefristete Direkteinstellung beim Kunden
description:
Für ein international tätiges Unternehmen im Bereich Healthcare- und Krankenhausbau suchen wir einen Biomedical Engineer (w/m/d), der anspruchsvolle Projekte von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung begleitet.

Sie arbeiten an modernen medizinischen Einrichtungen, bringen Ihre technische Expertise in interdisziplinäre Projektteams ein und gestalten Lösungen an der Schnittstelle zwischen Medizintechnik, Architektur und klinischen Anforderungen.

Nach einer umfassenden Einarbeitung am deutschen Standort in Bayern (Wohnung vorhanden) übernehmen Sie Ihre Tätigkeit langfristig in Bozen und wirken dort an internationalen Healthcare- und Krankenhausprojekten mit.

Aufgaben

  • Sie planen und konzipieren die medizintechnische Ausstattung von Krankenhäusern und weiteren Gesundheitseinrichtungen
  • Sie erstellen und pflegen raumbezogene Ausstattungsplanungen für medizintechnische Geräte und Systeme
  • Auf Basis klinischer Prozesse und Arbeitsabläufe wirken Sie bei der funktionalen Planung und Abstimmung von Räumen und Bereichen mit
  • Sie erstellen und bearbeiten Planungsunterlagen mit AutoCAD und Revit
  • Sie übernehmen die Positionierung und planerische Integration medizintechnischer Geräte und Systeme in Grundrissen

  • Sie definieren gemeinsam mit den Projektteams die technischen und infrastrukturellen Voraussetzungen für den Einsatz medizintechnischer Geräte
  • Sie wirken an internationalen Krankenhaus- und Medizintechnikprojekten mit
  • Sie koordinieren technische Fragestellungen und Anforderungen mit Herstellern und Lieferanten medizintechnischer Systeme

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium der Medizintechnik, Biomedical Engineering, Medizinischen Ingenieurwissenschaften, Technischen Medizin oder eine vergleichbare technisch-naturwissenschaftliche Qualifikation
  • Sie besitzen sehr gute Kenntnisse in AutoCAD und/oder Revit
  • Sie bringen ein gutes technisches Verständnis sowie Kenntnisse medizintechnischer Geräte und Systeme mit und können technische Anforderungen sicher in planerische Lösungen übertragen
  • Sie arbeiten strukturiert, präzise und eigenverantwortlich und finden sich schnell in komplexe technische und klinische Zusammenhänge ein
  • Die Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams liegt Ihnen; dabei kommunizieren Sie klar und verbindlich mit Ärzten, Pflegepersonal, Architekten, Ingenieuren und weiteren Projektbeteiligten
  • Sie kommunizieren sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch; weitere Fremdsprachenkenntnisse, insbesondere Italienisch und Französisch, sind willkommen
  • Sie bringen die für internationale Projekte erforderliche Reisebereitschaft mit

Benefits

  • Eine intensive fachliche Einarbeitung über 3–6 Monate in Bayern – für diesen Zeitraum wird Ihnen eine Wohnung zur Verfügung gestellt

  • Ein langfristiger Arbeitsplatz in Bozen im Herzen Südtirols – mit hoher Lebensqualität, alpiner Umgebung und italienischem Lebensgefühl

  • Die Mitarbeit an anspruchsvollen und innovativen Krankenhaus- und Medizintechnikprojekten im internationalen Umfeld

  • Ein vielseitiges Tätigkeitsfeld an der Schnittstelle von Medizin, Medizintechnik, Architektur, technischer Gebäudeplanung und Digitalisierung

  • Direkte Einblicke in klinische Prozesse und Abläufe sowie deren Umsetzung in moderne Krankenhausplanung

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und die Möglichkeit, nach Absprache bis zu einen Tag pro Woche mobil zu arbeiten

  • Viel Raum für eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und langfristige fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit abwechslungsreichen Projekten und unterschiedlichen Projektpartnern

  • Sie möchten Ihre Erfahrung in der Medizintechnik in internationale Krankenhausprojekte einbringen und können sich Bozen als zukünftigen Arbeits- und Lebensmittelpunkt vorstellen? Dann freue ich mich darauf, Sie kennenzulernen

  • Bewerben Sie sich unkompliziert mit Ihrem Lebenslauf. Für einen ersten vertraulichen Austausch stehe ich Ihnen gerne zur Verfügung

title: Partnerships Manager (all genders) B2B SaaS for KMU
description:
German SMEs carry an unavoidable administrative load: bookkeeping, monthly VAT returns, annual accounts. Work that must happen, that nobody wants to do, and that has stayed far too expensive.

mika takes it over. Because compliance is mandatory rather than optional, what we are building is infrastructure, and the purpose is to reduce the cost of doing business in Germany.

We went from 100 to over 700 customers in eight months and remain a small team. Roles here are therefore wide: you own an area rather than a slice of one, there is more to build than there are people to build it, and your scope grows as you do. We work in English, the team is international, the market is German.

Tasks

Partner and referral leads arrive already trusting us, which is the hardest part of our sale to manufacture any other way. We have only recently started testing this properly and it is already carrying a meaningful share of new pipeline. The pieces exist and nobody holds them together.

Networker and closer, in one person. Partnerships attracts people who are wonderful in a room, know everybody, and never sign anything. It also attracts people who can close but cannot keep a relationship alive past the signature. We need both halves.

And we need somebody who knows that a partnership is more than paying someone to send us customers. The ones that last are built on something both sides actually want: a better answer for their own customers, a gap in their offering closed, a reason for them to look good. If your instinct is to open with a commission rate, this is not the role.

You build the channel across referral and integration partners and the programmes around them, and you shape where it goes beyond that. We will talk about the specifics in the process.

what you will do

  • Own the channel and its number end to end
  • Close. Take partnerships from first conversation to signed agreement, including the commercial negotiation.
  • Structure the deals yourself. Work out what the partner gets, at which price tier, on the subscription or on the one-off revenue or both, over what period. You should know our unit economics well enough to say no without asking.
  • Own what happens after signature: technical handover, partner onboarding, and the routing rule agreed with the sales lead
  • Own the affiliate programme and our comparison-page strategy, working with our creative lead on production
  • Own our presence at events and conferences, where a surprising share of partnerships actually start
  • Prepare joint marketing with existing partners: webinars, co-branded content, campaigns
  • Apply our values filter honestly. Not every partner who would send us volume is one we want, and we would rather you turned one down than explained it afterwards.

Requirements

what you bring to the table

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner rather than a tool you open occasionally. You augment your own output with it and you automate the parts of your job that should not need a human.
  • You have closed partnership deals yourself, negotiated the terms, and can name what they produced afterwards
  • Ideally a real network in the German SME and entrepreneurship world, or in fintech.
  • You are commercially fluent. Revenue share, referral fees, attribution windows, exclusivity, minimum commitments: you model a deal and defend the structure.
  • You understand a business well enough to build the case from the partner's side rather than pitching at them
  • You follow up relentlessly and you keep partners warm after launch, which is where most partnerships quietly die
  • You are organised enough to run many parallel conversations without letting any of them go cold

the level we are hiring at

If you have been the second person in a function somewhere good and this is your step up, that is the profile we want. We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves. As the team grows, the path from here leads to Head of Partnerships.

We keep the team small by giving people leverage instead of headcount. That is why the AI point above is a requirement rather than a preference, and it is what lets one person hold more live conversations at once than this job would otherwise allow.

nice to have

  • German fintech or banking ecosystem
  • Platform and marketplace partnerships
  • Comfortable in a technical scoping conversation, enough to know what is easy and what is not
  • Affiliate and influencer programmes
  • API integrations and partner onboarding flows
  • Event and conference experience

German at C1 or above is preferred. The ecosystem we are building in is German and so are most of the negotiations. For an exceptional candidate we would work with English alone, so if the rest fits, apply anyway. English at B2 or above in either case, since it is our working language.

Benefits

Base 60,000 to 80,000 EUR depending on experience, plus a variable component tied to activated partners and partner-sourced revenue rather than to pipeline volume, plus stock options. On-target earnings 75,000 to 100,000 EUR.

Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. Depending on seniority there is an optional fourth conversation with one of our investors or mentors. One meeting happens in person in Berlin, and you hear back within a week at every stage, including if the answer is no.

why mika?

  • A channel with no incumbent owner, so its shape is your call.
  • Room, and the expectation that you use it. We hire people who do not need managing and then give them space to grow into more than the job they were hired for.
  • Deals you structure yourself, rather than terms handed to you
  • Founders in the detail with you, and no layer between you and a decision
  • A category nobody has built. German business owners do not know an alternative to their tax advisor exists, which is also why the right partner is worth so much to us.

title: Consultant Decision Intelligence (m/w/d)
description:
Du entscheidest mit dem CFO, welche fünfzehn Kennzahlen sein Unternehmen künftig steuern.

Montag: Kick-off bei einem Maschinenbauer mit 400 Mitarbeitenden. In anderen Tech-Unternehmen heißt dieselbe Arbeit Deployment Strategist, Value Engineer oder Client Value Partner.

ValueWorks ist eine Decision-Intelligence-Plattform für Geschäftsführungen, CFOs und Private-Equity-Investoren im deutschsprachigen Raum. Wir verbinden die Daten aus den Systemen, die unsere Kunden ohnehin haben, in einem semantischen Layer zu einem konsistenten Bild des Unternehmens — und machen daraus Steuerung: Reporting, Diagnose, Planung, OKR. Vier bis acht Wochen bis zum ersten Dashboard.

Gegründet wurde ValueWorks von einem Team aus McKinsey, Bain und SAP — mit entsprechend viel Erfahrung darin, wie Unternehmen tatsächlich gesteuert werden und woran Steuerung in der Praxis scheitert.

Aufgaben

Kick-off und Zielbild: Du moderierst den Kick-off-Workshop — Geschäftsmodell, Systemlandschaft über zehn Prozessbereiche, Pain Points der Führungsmannschaft.

Use Cases ableiten und priorisieren: Aus der Systemlandschaft entwickelst du, was für diesen Kunden möglich und wertvoll ist — von der P&L-Restrukturierung über Pipeline-Forecasts bis zur Churn-Prognose aus CRM-, Support- und Produktdaten. Priorisierung nach Wichtigkeit und Umsetzbarkeit, daraus schneidest du die Umsetzungswellen.

Kennzahlen definieren: Du bringst Finance und Fachbereich zu einer gemeinsamen Definition von „Auftragseingang" oder „DSO" und übersetzt sie so, dass sie im semantischen Layer eindeutig umsetzbar ist. Der anspruchsvollste und wertvollste Teil der Arbeit.

Umsetzung begleiten: Du arbeitest mit unseren Forward Deployed Engineers, die Pipelines und Datenprodukte bauen — du bringst die fachliche Logik, sie die technische Umsetzung. Du validierst die Ergebnisse vor der Übergabe.

Mehrere Mandate parallel führen: Du betreust typischerweise mehrere Kundenprojekte gleichzeitig — jedes mit eigenem Takt, eigenen Stakeholdern und eigener Wellenplanung. Sauber priorisieren, Zusagen halten und nach beiden Seiten klar kommunizieren ist in dieser Rolle genauso entscheidend wie analytische Schärfe.

Wirkung sichern und das Mandat weiterentwickeln: Wöchentlicher Jour Fixe, Wave Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews mit der Geschäftsführung. Du siehst, ob deine Dashboards Entscheidungen verändern — und wenn sie es tun, wächst die Zusammenarbeit: Kunden verlängern und nehmen weitere Bereiche dazu. Daran misst sich der Erfolg dieser Rolle.

Was diese Rolle nicht ist: kein Ticket-Support, keine Hotline, keine Service-SLAs. Keine Neukunden- oder Kaltakquise — die Kundenbeziehungen, die du führst, bestehen bereits. Und kein Projektmanagement ohne fachlichen Inhalt: du entscheidest inhaltlich mit, nicht nur über Termine.

SQL sicher oder die Bereitschaft, es in den ersten Wochen zu lernen. Du baust keine Pipelines, aber du verstehst, was in ihnen passiert.

Kommunikationsstärke: Du erklärst ein Datenmodell einem CFO und eine betriebswirtschaftliche Logik einem Data Engineer — und bewegst dich in beiden Gesprächen sicher

Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch fließend

title: Brand & Communications Lead  (all genders) B2B SaaS for KMU
description:
Small and medium businesses are the backbone of the German economy, and a painful share of their time and cash disappears into compliance. Bookkeeping, VAT returns, annual accounts. Mandatory, joyless, overpriced.

We are building the infrastructure that changes it. Since none of this work is optional, it is closer to infrastructure than to software, and our reason to do it is to lower the cost of doing business in Germany.

Eight months took us from 100 to more than 700 customers, and we are still small. That shapes every role here: a whole area to own, more to build than there are people, and scope that expands with you. English is our working language, the team is international, the market is German.

Tasks

We are looking for a very particular kind of person.

Somebody who can move a brand forward in words, in images and emotionally, all three at once. How we come across is one thing, not three, and it falls apart the moment the copy, the visuals and the feeling get decided separately by people pulling in different directions.

Here is why it matters more here than in most companies. Our subject is bookkeeping, finance and annual accounts. Objectively one of the least exciting things a business owner deals with, and an industry that looks and sounds exactly like that. Our entire bet is that we do not feel like that industry: approachable, likeable, close to the customer, never intimidating. Somebody has to hold that line in every ad, every page, every video and every email, and keep holding it as the volume goes up.

We are asking people to hand over their books. Whether they trust us enough to do that is largely decided by how we come across, long before anybody speaks to sales. That is why this is one of our first senior hires rather than a later one.

how the job actually works

You make things. With AI in the loop, and without needing somebody else to execute before anything can go out.

That does not mean being the best in the room at everything. It means being good enough across the board to move on your own, and then deliberately bringing in people who are better than you at specific things. Freelancers first, colleagues later. A motion designer who is stronger than you are. An illustrator with a hand you do not have.

What stays with you either way is the judgment: what goes out, what does not, and why.

what you will do

  • Own how mika sounds and looks everywhere: ads, landing pages, website, social, video, decks, events
  • Write and make. Headlines, ad copy, page copy, campaign concepts, and the visuals that carry them.
  • Make a dry subject genuinely good. Boring is a choice, not a property of the material.
  • Hold the standard for everything the company publishes, including work made elsewhere in the team or bought outside
  • Build the system: components, templates and copy patterns, so good work does not depend on you being in the room
  • Build the bench. Bring or find the freelancers, brief them properly, and judge what comes back.
  • Own our visual identity refresh, across brand and the product surfaces

Requirements

what you bring to the table

  • AI-native, and able to judge what comes out of it. Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner. Generating is the easy part here: the value is that you can look at ten outputs and know which one is right and why. That judgment is what we are actually hiring.
  • Words and images from the same person. Show us work where you wrote the copy as well as made the piece.
  • Solid fundamentals on both sides: type, layout, hierarchy and restraint, and a voice that sounds like a person rather than a brand guideline
  • You have made a dry or technical subject feel good, not just look tidy
  • Brand work and performance work in the same career
  • A network of freelancers you can pull on: motion, design, illustration, video, content. A strong plus, and the thing that makes a small team look bigger than it is.
  • You can take a weak asset apart on the spot and say what is wrong with it, in the copy and in the layout

the level we are hiring at

Senior enough that nobody needs to brief you on what good looks like. We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves.

We are not hiring a head of brand above you. The intention is that this role becomes it as the team grows.

nice to have

  • A rebrand or identity refresh you carried through to implementation. Motion and video craft. Product and UX design alongside brand. Fintech, tax, insurance or another category where trust has to be designed. Webflow.

German at C2 or above is required. You are writing the copy, and in this market whether a line lands cannot be judged in translation. English at B2 or above, since it is our working language.

Benefits

Base 65,000 to 90,000 EUR depending on experience, plus stock options.

Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. Depending on seniority there is an optional fourth conversation with one of our investors or mentors. One meeting happens in person in Berlin, and you hear back within a week at every stage, including if the answer is no.

why mika?

  • You decide how mika looks and sounds. Not inside a style guide somebody else wrote. You write the guide.
  • Room, and the expectation that you use it. We hire people who do not need managing and then give them space to grow into more than the job they were hired for. Fully flexible hours apart from the daily standup.
  • A category nobody has built. There is no established visual or verbal language for what we are, which means the one you make becomes it.
  • A path into leading brand, if you want it
  • Founders in the detail with you, and no layer between you and a decision
  • Work that matters outside the building. Every customer we win gets back time and money that was disappearing into paperwork, and how we come across is a large part of why they trust us enough to switch.

Send us your portfolio and point us at one piece where you wrote the copy as well as designed it.

title: Growth Engineer (all genders) SaaS/Fintech
description:
Every company in Germany has to keep books, file VAT and produce annual accounts. It is unavoidable, unloved and far more expensive than it needs to be, and it lands hardest on the smallest businesses.

mika is the infrastructure that takes it off them. None of this work is optional, which is what makes it infrastructure rather than a product, and the point of building it is to lower the cost of doing business in Germany.

From 100 to more than 700 customers in eight months, and still a small team. Which is why this role is broad, why you own an area instead of a slice of one, and why your scope grows at the speed you do. We work in English, we are international, our market is German. y positive surprise. Choosing one is also a big decision: several steps and several touchpoints before anyone moves. One ad and one landing page do not close it.

Tasks

You run our growth experiments end to end. You bring the questions worth answering, agree the hypothesis with the founders, build the test yourself, and measure it properly.

End to end includes the measurement. Instrumentation, attribution and whatever needs fixing in HubSpot for a result to be trustworthy are part of running the experiment, not somebody else's ticket.

We are looking for a marketer who can build, not an engineer who supports marketing. Knowing which hypothesis is worth the week matters more here than the code, and you write the German variants yourself instead of waiting for copy.

what you will do

  • Shape the test agenda with the founders, and sync with the rest of growth wherever an experiment touches their area
  • Build what the test needs: landing pages, flows, tools, integrations, automations. The simplest version that will confirm or kill the hypothesis, in days (or better hours) rather than sprints.
  • Be self-sufficient
  • Make the measurement trustworthy. Tracking, attribution, the data model and the HubSpot side of it. Our pipeline data is not yet reliable enough to steer by, and getting it there is part of the job.
  • Read results honestly, including when they kill your own idea, and write down what we learned so nobody relearns it in six months

Requirements

what you bring to the table

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner rather than a tool you open occasionally. You augment your own output with it and you automate the parts of your job that should not need a human. Here it is a baseline, not a differentiator: you would find working without it slow.
  • You are a marketer first. Funnel, messaging, positioning, offer, what actually moves a number. We’re not looking for an engineer who “builds what marketing wants”
  • We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves. You have built and launched something of your own, or run a function as if it were your own company.
  • You have run experiments without being handed hypotheses. Talk us through a real one: what you expected, what happened, what you changed.
  • Visual and copy judgment. You can lay out a page that looks intentional, write the headline, and say precisely why a weak version is weak.
  • Ideally you have worked with Hubspot, BigQuery, Chargebee/Stripe

the level we are hiring at

  • This is a senior individual contributor role and it stays one. Your influence grows
    through the scope of what you own and what you are trusted to decide, not through people reporting to you.
  • We care about the combination more than the years. Somebody with two years who hasgenuinely run their own experiments end to end beats somebody with ten who has alwayshad the hypothesis handed to them or people who executed for them.
  • We are relaxed about what this has been called on your CV. Growth engineer, growth
    hacker, technical marketer, creative technologist, solo founder who built their own
    funnel: if the description above is you, apply.

German at C1 or above is required. You write the variants and the messaging you test, and in this market that judgment cannot be delegated. English at B2 or above, since English is our working language.

Benefits

Base 70,000 to 100,000 + EUR depending on experience, plus stock options.

Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. Depending on seniority there is an optional fourth conversation with one of our investors or mentors. One meeting happens in person in Berlin, and you hear back within a week at every stage, including if the answer is no.

why mika?

  • Real influence on what we test. You shape the agenda with the founders rather than working through somebody's backlog, on a funnel with a lot of untested surface and a budget behind it.
  • Room, and the expectation that you use it. We hire people who do not need managing and then give them space to grow into more than the job they were hired for. Fully flexible hours apart from the daily standup.
  • Founders in the detail with you, and no layer between you and a decision
  • Work that matters outside the building. Every experiment that works means more small businesses spending less time and money on paperwork they never chose.

Send us your CV plus something you built and something you tested. The test matters more to us than the build.

At mika, we value diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive. Join us in building the future of small business finance!

description:
We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our design team. You'll take features end to end, from research and flows through to the finished interface, for an analytics platform that mobile gaming studios use every day to decide where their marketing money goes. You'll also own our design system: the components, patterns and documentation that everything else is built from. This is a broad role. You'll do research, interaction design, visual design and system work, and you'll do it in a small team where your decisions ship.

At justtrack, we build a SaaS business that provides app and game publishers with an attractive toolset to manage their entire global growth marketing process. Starting from managing, analyzing, and automating marketing processes, justtrack enables gathering deep mobile product insights. As part of the Applike Group (financially backed by media powerhouse Bertelsmann), justtrack has access to industry experts and funding with a long-term growth mindset.

What you will do:

  • Work AI-First: Use AI tools as a standard part of your design process, research synthesis, copy, design generation and iteration, with the judgement to know where the output needs your correction.

  • Own Features End to End: Take features from problem statement through research, flows and interface to shipped result, without handing off between layers.

  • Own the Design System: Build, document, and evolve our design system, components, variants, states, tokens, and decide how it changes as the product grows.

  • Design for Data Density: Design charts and data-heavy screens where information hierarchy and readability matter more than decoration.

  • Design AI-Assisted Surfaces: Shape how our AI features present their output, transparency, confidence, review steps, and what happens when the model gets it wrong.

  • Work Closely with Engineering: Specify components so frontend can build them directly, and review the built result against the design.

  • Talk to Users: Run research and usability tests with gaming studios and internal stakeholders, and turn what you learn into design decisions.

Who you are:

  • Experience: You have 5+ years in product design or a comparable end-to-end design role, ideally on a complex SaaS product.

  • Background: A degree in design, HCI, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • AI Fluency: You already work with AI tools day to day and have a clear view of where they help and where they don't.

  • End-to-End Craft: You're strong across the whole range: research, flows, interaction and visual design, rather than deep in one and dependent on others for the rest.

  • Design System Expertise: You've built and maintained a design system in production, including documentation and the governance decisions that keep it coherent.

  • Tools: Expert in Figma. It's where our final designs live, and where our design system is built and maintained.

  • Portfolio: You have a strong portfolio showing end-to-end work, the problem, your decisions, the finished interface, and what it changed.

  • Collaboration: You work well with product owners and engineers, articulate your rationale clearly, and can hold a position without stalling the work.

  • Optional: Experience designing for analytics, data visualization, or another data-dense environment.

  • Optional: Familiarity with front-end frameworks (e.g. React) and component development tools (e.g. Storybook).

Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

  • Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

  • Easy Arrival to justtrack: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at applike in Hamburg? We support every ambition - from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

  • Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster Lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

  • Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

  • 1st: Interview with TA

  • 2nd: Interview with the Lead UX/UI Designer

  • 3rd: On-site day in our Hamburg office, a case study, followed by an interview with the design team and our Director of Product

  • 4th: Team fit call with our Managing Director

title: Sales Lead (all genders) SaaS/Fintech
description:
Germany runs on its small and medium businesses, and far too much of their money and attention goes into staying compliant. Bookkeeping, VAT returns, annual accounts: unavoidable work that nobody wants and everybody overpays for.

We take it off them. Because none of it is optional, what we are building is infrastructure rather than software, and the purpose is simple: make it cheaper to run a company in Germany.

100 to more than 700 customers in eight months, and still a small team. So these roles are broad by design. You own an area, not a slice of one, there is more to build than there are people, and the scope grows as fast as you do. We work in English internally, as the team is international, but the market is German.

Aufgaben

You own our sales engine: the team, the numbers and the motions we sell through.

What you inherit on day one. Two sales people, one freelance closer, and everything our COO and CFO has been carrying alongside his actual job. So you are a playing coach for the first months: you carry your own book, you coach two people, and you hire the next ones yourself rather than being handed a team.

Our pipeline today is almost entirely inbound. Outbound is a motion we expect to build, and we do not yet know how large a part of the mix it becomes. We need somebody who has run both, because the answer depends on what you find.

We have deliberately not decided what the sales team should look like. There are too many sensible ways to build one, and the right shape depends on which motions prove out. You design that structure with us and then you hire it, which is why hiring experience is not negotiable in this role.

what you will do

  • Own win rate, cycle time and average contract value as your numbers, per motion rather than in aggregate
  • Own sales operations and bring structure to a team that has grown without much of it: process, cadence, forecasting, routing rules, quota and commission design, a CRM somebody can trust
  • Design the shape of the sales team with us, then hire it. Which roles, which split, in which order.
  • Hire, onboard and coach the reps. You are accountable for who joins the team, not only for what they do afterwards.
  • Run inbound properly and build outbound from close to nothing, then be honest about which one deserves the next hire
  • Build the consultative motion for larger contract values. Our subscription tiers are small, and a meaningful part of first-year revenue comes from one-off work such as prior-year closings, which is where the larger deals sit.
  • Use the deadlines the business already has. VAT returns, annual accounts, the notice period on an existing advisor contract: there is always a clock, and finding it and using it is a large part of closing here.
  • Keep selling. You should be closing enough yourself to know what the reps are hearing.

Where your job ends. Our partnerships manager closes the partner agreements, including grey label. You own the routing of those leads and their conversion into revenue.

Qualifikation

what you bring to the table

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner rather than a tool you open occasionally. You augment your own output with it and you automate the parts of your job that should not need a human. In this role that means call analysis and objection patterns, follow-up drafting, research before a conversation, and the reporting you would otherwise ask somebody else to build for you.
  • You have hired sales people before, and some of them worked out. You can describe what you screen for and what you got wrong.
  • We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves, whether that was your own company or a function you ran as if it were one
  • You have run both inbound and outbound yourself, not managed one and read about the other
  • You have led a small B2B sales team in a high-volume environment and carried the number yourself before that
  • You build structure without building bureaucracy. Playbooks and process that reps actually use.
  • You can tell the difference between a rep who processes what arrives and a rep who goes and gets it, in an interview rather than in month four
  • You are commercially literate. You can hold a conversation about pricing, structure and what a deal can afford without escalating every question.
  • You coach directly and you are honest about who is not working out
  • You are honest in the CRM even when the number is ugly

the level we are hiring at

If you have been the second person in a function somewhere good and this is your step up, that is the profile we want. As the team grows, the path from here is Head of Sales.

We keep the team small by giving people leverage instead of headcount. That is why the AI point above is a requirement rather than a preference, and why we expect everyone here to get visibly better at it every month.

nice to have

  • Tax, accounting, SME-stack or fintech background
  • Franchise systems, multi-entity groups or holding structures
  • Partner-led or channel sales
  • Experience in a company that grew fast around you

German at native or C2 level is required. Every sales conversation, every negotiation and every coaching session on a live call happens in German. English at B2 or above, since English is our team language.

Benefits

Base 75,000 to 100,000 EUR depending on experience, plus a variable component. It starts weighted to what you close yourself and shifts toward team performance as the team grows. On-target earnings 95,000 to 150,000 EUR+, plus stock options.

Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. For a role at this level there is a fourth conversation with one of our investors or mentors. One meeting happens in person in Berlin, and you hear back within a week at every stage, including if the answer is no.

why mika?

  • The engine is yours to build. Selling here already works. Turning it into a system is the job, which means you are deciding what it looks like rather than inheriting somebody else's.
  • Room, and the expectation that you use it. We hire people who do not need managing and then give them space to grow into more than the job they were hired for. Fully flexible hours apart from the daily standup.
  • Founders in the detail with you, and no layer between you and a decision
  • A category nobody has built. German business owners do not know an alternative to their tax advisor exists, so you are opening a market rather than taking share in one.
  • Work that matters outside the building. Every customer you close gets back time and money that was disappearing into paperwork.

Send us your CV, the numbers your team hit under you, and one hire you made that did not work out and what you learned from it.

GPS goes dark. Signals get jammed. Most drones fall out of the sky. Ours don't.

title: Principal AI & Agent Systems Engineer (gn) @ Fusion Energy Venture, Munich
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We are building a new path to fusion energy. Every major leap in human civilisation has followed a breakthrough in energy, from fire to steam to electricity, and we believe fusion is the next one. Our bet is that it will not come from building bigger machines. It will come from controlling matter with enough precision that fusion becomes a manufacturable technology, atoms aligned exactly enough that fusion happens under controlled conditions, on a chip. This is a semiconductor-scale path to clean power, and our stance is precision over brute force. We start in physics and simulation, then build the physical proof. 

About the Role

Reaching a chip-scale approach means working through physics and simulation at a depth that is hard to reach by conventional means, and to do that we need a new class of scientific intelligence. You will work directly with the founders to design that system from the ground up: an AI-driven research platform that can read papers, connect ideas across disciplines, orchestrate simulations, evaluate hypotheses and learn from results. This is not a chatbot or prompt engineering role, and we are not building a foundation model or competing with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. We believe these systems will need richer representations than today's token-prediction models, so you will help explore new architectures for scientific reasoning, memory, hypothesis generation and autonomous discovery. The better that system works, the faster we get to the physical proof.

What you'll do

  • Design multi-agent research systems and the orchestration that ties them together

  • Build long-term memory architectures for scientific reasoning

  • Create paper ingestion and knowledge extraction pipelines

  • Develop scientific reasoning workflows and connect AI agents to simulation environments

  • Build autonomous experiment and evaluation loops

  • Design retrieval, planning and orchestration systems

  • Integrate state-of-the-art LLMs and open-source models

  • Develop scalable infrastructure for continuous learning

  • Explore next-generation AI architectures for scientific discovery

About You

We care far more about what you have built than about formal credentials. You will thrive here if you enjoy solving problems nobody has solved before, learn quickly and independently, and are comfortable with uncertainty. This role suits someone who wants to help create a new category of scientific intelligence rather than optimise an existing product.

  • You have already built real agent systems, with strong experience across several of: multi-agent architectures, tool use and function calling, agent orchestration, planning systems, long-term memory, knowledge graphs, autonomous research workflows, RAG architectures and evaluation frameworks

  • You write production-quality software with strong Python skills, and you are comfortable with API design and integration

  • You know your way around cloud infrastructure, Docker and containerisation, and databases including vector databases

  • You are comfortable with the mathematical ideas this work draws on, such as linear algebra, optimisation, probability, graph theory and dynamical systems

  • You do not need to be a theoretical physicist, but you should enjoy working on highly technical scientific problems

Nice to have:

  • Physics simulations, scientific computing or computational physics

  • HPC environments

  • Reinforcement learning

  • AI for Science

  • Quantum computing

  • Scientific publishing workflows

  • Open-source AI frameworks

Why Join

  • Our goal is bigger than software. The systems you build will be used to accelerate research in fusion energy, scientific discovery, advanced simulation, AI for physics and quantum technologies. Success here is measured in real scientific progress.

  • Work with an exceptional founding team with scientific and commercial track records across places like LMU, Apple, Amazon, Eurazeo, Sprin-D and McKinsey. Around them is a small group of physicists, simulation experts and AI specialists who value curiosity, independent thinking and the courage to challenge assumptions.

  • We are remote-first, so you can work from Munich, Berlin, London, Lisbon or wherever you do your best work. We keep bureaucracy to a minimum so talented people can move fast and follow promising ideas.

  • This is a chance to help build something before it becomes obvious, and to help solve one of humanity's hardest problems.

We are building the robotics platform that combines traditional manufacturing with modern software engineering - enabling developers to build robotics applications using modern software engineering principles on top of a reliable robotics core. Cameras are becoming a core part of this platform. From vision-guided robotics to AI-driven applications, the ability to manipulate the physical world depends on sensing the physical world first.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the foundation for integrating cameras into our cloud-native platform. Instead of developing one-off integrations, you will design and implement a scalable integration framework that enables both Wandelbots engineers and camera manufacturers to integrate new devices with minimal effort.

Together with other Wandelbots engineers, you will define the architecture, build the first production-ready camera drivers yourself, and create the SDK and interfaces that make future integrations repeatable. Working closely with infrastructure & robotics engineers, product teams, and hardware partners, you will shape how vision devices become a substantial part of the Wandelbots ecosystem. The camera integration framework will become a component of the Wandelbots platform, running inside our Kubernetes infrastructure alongside the rest of our robotics stack.


Your profile

This role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, backend engineering, and industrial vision. We don't expect anyone to be an expert in every area. Instead, we're looking for someone with a strong engineering foundation, who has previously designed APIs and has deep expertise in at least one of the following domains:
Industrial Vision & Camera Integration: You have integrated industrial cameras into production systems and understand how they are used in automation projects.
Camera Development: You have worked for a camera manufacturer or built camera software, SDKs, or device interfaces.
Cloud-native Hardware Platforms: You have experience building Kubernetes-based systems that discover, manage, and control hardware devices, including custom resources and Kubernetes controllers.

Further required Skills:
Several years of experience building backend systems (e.g. Python, Go)
API design and versioning
Comfortable developing containerized software and familiar with Kubernetes-based deployments.
Ability to take ownership of architecture, make technical decisions, and drive projects from concept to production

Awesome if you have:

Strong experience extending Kubernetes using Custom Resources, Operators, or Controllers.
Experience with Kubernetes networking for hardware and network-attached devices.
Experience integrating vendor SDKs behind a common abstraction layer.
Experience with Linux device management and exposing hardware into containers
Experience with industrial cameras, media pipelines, or camera protocols
Understanding of computer vision concepts such as calibration, depth imaging, and point clouds.
Experience with video streaming and media handling.
Background in robotics or industrial automation.

What we care about:

We are looking for an engineer who enjoys building platforms rather than one-off integrations. You should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, making architectural decisions, and creating systems that others can successfully build upon.
This is an opportunity to build the foundation for every camera integration at Wandelbots. You won't just implement the first integrations - you'll define the architecture, SDK, and developer experience that camera manufacturers, partners, and internal teams will use for years to come.


Why us?

Make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

title: Senior Rollout Manager (f/m/x) – DACH
description:
Your mission

IONITY baut ein europaweites Netzwerk von High-Power-Ladestationen auf und betreibt dieses. Als Senior Rollout Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung mehrerer Ladestandorte in der DACH-Region – von der Rollout-Planung und der Standortvorbereitung über die Bauphase, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme bis zur Übergabe an Operations. Du überführst komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Projekte in einen planbaren und verlässlichen Rollout neuer Standorte.
Die Rolle verbindet Projektmanagement, Infrastrukturentwicklung und Stakeholder-Management. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards. Deine Arbeit leistet einen direkten Beitrag zum Wachstum des europäischen IONITY Netzwerks, sowie einem zuverlässigen Ladeerlebnis für Elektrofahrzeugfahrerinnen und -fahrer aus ganz Europa. Jede neue Ladesäule als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit beschleunigt die Verkehrswende und ist ein wichtiger Beitrag für eine emissionsfreie Mobilität.

  • Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Umsetzung eines Portfolios von HPC-Ladestandorten in der DACH-Region, mit besonderem Fokus auf die komplexesten, risikoreichsten oder strategisch wichtigsten Standorte. Über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg steuerst du Umfang, Zeitplan, Abhängigkeiten, Risikoexponierung, Kostenrisiken, Qualität, Sicherheit, Compliance und die betriebliche Umsetzungsreife.
  • Du übersetzt die Rollout-Ziele in integrierte Standort- und Portfolioumsetzungspläne, definierst Prioritäten, Reihenfolgen, Meilensteine und Abhängigkeiten und stellst eine klare Governance sicher – von der Standortentwicklung und Genehmigungsplanung über die Bauphase und Inbetriebnahme bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du führst die funktionsübergreifende Umsetzung über die Bereiche Planung und Genehmigung, Bau, Netzanschluss, Logistik etc. hinweg, treibst zeitnahe Entscheidungen voran, löst Konflikte und stellst sicher, dass kritische Schnittstellen zwischen Grundstück, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Installation der Ladehardware, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme aktiv gesteuert werden.
  • Du steuerst externe Planungsbüros, Auftragnehmer, Installationsunternehmen und weitere Umsetzungspartner direkt, setzt klare Erwartungen, überwachst die Leistung, steuerst die operative Umsetzung sowie kommerzielle Risiken und stellst sicher, dass die Partner die vereinbarten Ergebnisse liefern.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Risiko-, Änderungs- und Maßnahmenmanagement des Portfolios, identifizierst kritische Risiken frühzeitig, definierst Gegenmaßnahmen und führst Wiederherstellungspläne für verspätete, blockierte oder erheblich vom Plan abweichende Standorte. Dabei schützt du Umsetzungsqualität, Sicherheit und Compliance.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen innerhalb deines übertragenen Verantwortungs- und Entscheidungsrahmens und erstellst klare Entscheidungsvorlagen für den Country Manager DACH, sofern eine Eskalation erforderlich ist. Du stellst tragfähige Optionen, Auswirkungen und Empfehlungen dar und wägst dabei Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, technische Machbarkeit und die Anforderungen der Stakeholder gegeneinander ab.
  • Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern, lokalen Stakeholdern und Umsetzungspartnern auf und pflegst diese, vertrittst IONITY auch in komplexen Gesprächen professionell und löst Genehmigungs-, Netzanschluss-, Grundstücks-, Bau- und sonstige Umsetzungshindernisse pragmatisch.
  • Du erstellst prägnante und entscheidungsorientierte Berichte für Senior Stakeholder, einschließlich Fortschritt, prognostizierter Termine, Prognosesicherheit, wesentlicher Risiken, Kosten- und kommerzieller Risiken, Partnerleistung, Maßnahmen zur Planwiederherstellung sowie der erforderlichen Entscheidungen, um das Portfolio auf Kurs zu halten.
  • Du etablierst und verbesserst kontinuierlich Rollout-Standards, Governance-Routinen, Vorlagen und Umsetzungsleitfäden. Auf Basis gewonnener Erkenntnisse erhöhst du die Planbarkeit, Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Umsetzungseffektivität des Rollouts im gesamten DACH-Netzwerk.


Your profile

  • Du bist ein Teamplayer und arbeitest auch unter Zeitdruck mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität.
  • Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung der Umsetzung komplexer Infrastruktur-, Bau-, Energie-, Mobilitäts-, Telekommunikations- oder vergleichbarer Rollout-Programme über mehrere Standorte hinweg, ideralerweise im Bereich HPC Ladeinfrastruktur.
  • Du kannst eine Erfolgsbilanz bei der Übernahme von Ergebnisverantwortung über den gesamten Umsetzungslebenszyklus vorweisen – und nicht nur für einzelne Projektaufgaben oder Arbeitspakete.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Kenntnisse in Programm- und Projektsteuerung, einschließlich integrierter Planung, Risikomanagement, Abhängigkeitsmanagement, Änderungssteuerung und Reporting auf Senior-Ebene.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Partner sowie in der Einflussnahme auf interne Stakeholder in einer Matrixorganisation. Du trittst sicher auf, stellst bestehende Ansätze konstruktiv infrage, triffst Entscheidungen und eskalierst Themen, wenn dies erforderlich ist.
  • Du verfügst über ein fundiertes praktisches Verständnis der Schnittstellen zwischen Standortentwicklung, Genehmigungsplanung, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und strukturiert auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein und bist bereit, regelmäßig mit Teams an den Standorten zusammenzuarbeiten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Ladeinfrastruktur für Elektrofahrzeuge, Anlagen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien oder anderer dezentraler, kundenorientierter Infrastruktur.
  • Du verfügst über etablierte Arbeitsbeziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern und Baupartnern in einem oder mehreren DACH-Märkten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Schnittstellen zu Hochspannungs- oder elektrotechnischer Infrastruktur sowie mit der Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe in ein operatives Netzwerk.
  • Du verfügst über gute Anwenderkenntnisse in AutoCAD und Microsoft Office, einschließlich fortgeschrittener Excel-Kenntnisse oder vergleichbarer Projektsteuerungs-Tools.
  • Du hast ein einschlägiges Hochschulstudium, eine technische Qualifikation oder vergleichbare berufliche Erfahrung in den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Bauwesen, Infrastruktur oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.

London

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

Essential

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
